scope: Ordinary Hong Kong company and sole-proprietor profits basis reconciliation
behavior: Saved receipts plus explicit taxable additions minus established exclusions and saved allowable deductions produces current assessable profits or adjusted loss before prior losses.
Eligible prior losses are separately limited to positive assessable profits. The resulting net taxable profits must equal the supplied rate base.
Current loss and unused prior loss remain separate; neither is a future carryforward award.
Persisted results include the reconciliation and two original IRD source snapshots; API rejects inconsistent bases without changing saved state.
compatibility: Legacy input/result field assessable_profits remains the historical rate-base amount for snapshot/request compatibility. The UI explicitly labels this input net taxable profits after loss relief; hong_kong_profits_reconciliation provides legally distinct current assessable profits and net taxable profits. New optional adjustment fields default to zero. Existing saved snapshots are not rewritten.

validation.browser: 2 passed in 30.1s; company and sole proprietor with 1.5m receipts and 0.5m deductions, saved result reopened
validation.source_integrity: Both archived SHA256 values verified in report persistence test
validation.rejection: Changed saved deduction/loss and invalid tax base rejected; API case revision/result preserved

limits: Eligibility and limits for statutory allowances/donations, source/FSIE and loss relief still require established supporting schedules.
Does not add partnership allocation, personal assessment, foreign credits or provisional tax.
Other jurisdictions and full business acceptance remain incomplete.
